title: lastreopsis manilensis
intro: Lastreopsis manilensis, commonly known as Philippine fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Lastreopsis manilensis include wound healing, anti-aging, and protection against neurodegenerative diseases, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These constituents have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties, making Lastreopsis manilensis a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
